rows.note: Use 咖啡 as the all-purpose noun for the beverage or a serving of it.

example.english: I usually drink coffee in the morning.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 tung1 soeng4 jam2 gaa3 fe1

rows.note: Use 咖啡豆 specifically for the beans used to make the drink.

example.english: These coffee beans were bought by a friend in Brazil.
example.traditional: 呢包咖啡豆係朋友喺巴西買返嚟嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 baau1 gaa3 fe1 dau6 hai6 pang4 jau5 hai2 baa1 sai1 maai5 faan1 lai4 ge3

rows.note: Use 咖啡色 for the coffee-brown color, especially when making the color reference explicit.

example.english: This shirt is the color of coffee and quite smart.
example.traditional: 呢件衫係咖啡色，幾斯文。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 hai6 gaa3 fe1 sik1 gei2 si1 man4

rows.note: Use the shorter 啡色 as a common alternative for the coffee-brown color.

example.english: This coffee color goes well with your room.
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 fe1 sik1 gei2 can3 nei5 gaan1 fong2
